units.text: The source e99ab8d0 confirms 27 January 1980 as the entry into force date for the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, with 'Coming into Force' and 'Registration Date' both listed as that date. Source e9c5c11a (Wikipedia) also states 'Effective | 27 January 1980'.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (UNTS v. 1155 (p.331)) - vLex International Law
Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The vLex passages list both 'Coming into Force' and 'Registration Date' as 27 January 1980 and state the Convention came into force on that date, while the Wikipedia passage lists 'Effective | 27 January 1980'.
